
{{alias}}( idx, max )
    Clips an index to the interval [0,max].

    Negative indices are normalized according to `max + idx`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    idx: integer
        Index to clip.

    max: integer
        Maximum index value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: integer
        Clipped index.

    Examples
    --------
    > var idx = {{alias}}( 2, 10 )
    2
    > idx = {{alias}}( -5, 10 )
    5
    > idx = {{alias}}( 15, 10 )
    10
    > idx = {{alias}}( -15, 10 )
    0

    See Also
    --------
